plain: A mathematical guarantee that the output of an analysis barely changes whether or not any one person's data is included.
eli5: Adding a little noise so nobody can tell whether your answer was in the survey.
technical: A formal privacy definition (Dwork et al. 2006) bounding how much any single record can change an algorithm's output distribution; the agentic-privacy report contrasts it with contextual integrity because it is context-agnostic by design.
